During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Republic forces under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] of the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit [[Havoc Squad]] '''drove back''' an invasion attempt by the Empire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karideph]]. Part of the twenty-eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[Minos Cluster Campaign]], the battle saw both Din and Tavus named the "Heroes of Karideph" for their bravery during the fighting.

==Prelude==
When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[3681 BBY]] and sparked the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] launched a [[Minos Cluster Campaign|campaign]] to conquer the resource-rich [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> The resulting offensive lasted the entire twenty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war,<ref name="Threat of Peace 1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Republic Army]] battling the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] and its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leaders across the entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]] for almost three decades.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was among the many Jedi who were stationed in the Minos Cluster for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]], and by the end of the war Din had seen more fighting alongside [[Republic soldier]]s than any other surviving Jedi. After the Republic defeated the Empire at the [[Battle of Alderaan]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Harron Tavus]] was recruited into [[Havoc Squad]]&mdash;an elite unit in the Republic's newly formed [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]], and he was eventually stationed in the Minos Cluster as well. Tavus and Din soon became friends, and the two led Republic forces on many highly successful raids against Imperial forces throughout the Minos Cluster.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==The battle==
Sometime before the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]], the Empire attempted to invade the planet [[Karideph]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a world whose main industry was the production of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> However, Din and Tavus led the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in a counterattack on Karideph, successfully turning back the Imperial offensive and forcing the Empire to abandon its invasion efforts.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Aftermath==
For their bravery and leadership in the battle on Karideph, both Din and Tavus were named the "Heroes of Karideph,"<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the two continued to serve in the battle for the Minos Cluster until the Empire withdrew its forces<ref name="Threat of Peace 1" /> in 3653 BBY<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as an [[Alderaan peace conference|offer of peace]].<ref name="Threat of Peace 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Karideph was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', under the entry for Orgus Din.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
